reproduction.safety: Fault injection intentionally raises in or exits a worker. Use only isolated test servers with approved GPU admission, a bounded maintenance window and a tested rollback. Keep generated observations and logs in this checkout's Git-ignored logs/incidents/ directory, never in Git.
external_inputs: Compatible Linux aarch64 CUDA runtime with native vLLM extensions matching the pinned base; the historical private base image is not distributed.
Two GPU hosts and operator-reviewed network/RDMA configuration, model cache, launch argument arrays, source-overlay mounts, and rollback. No launch manifest is bundled.
Expose the development collective-RPC endpoint only on the isolated test server. Make fault_extension importable and configure worker extension fault_extension.FailureProbeExtension on both hosts.
Verify installed module versions and source hashes on both workers before arming a fault; do not overlay these snapshots onto an unrelated vLLM binary.

helpers.client_probe.py: Python plus httpx; modes normal/cancel/failure/lora/report/speculative, --url direct vLLM root, --model, --timeout (default 60), --failure-mode exception|exit. report/failure require the test extension and collective RPC; lora requires LoRA-enabled serving; speculative requires speculative decoding metrics.
helpers.fault_extension.py: Synthetic forward pre-hook. failure targets rank 1 by default. Never install in production serving.
helpers.legacy_rpc_smoke.py: Python with the matching legacy vLLM runtime and historical backport installed. Uses real dispatch/pipes but stub model methods; not GPU inference proof.
helpers.render_launch.py: Prints only. Requires an external JSON object mapping host-a and host-b to command argument arrays plus HOST_A_IP, HOST_B_IP and HF_CACHE environment variables. Supports ${NAME} substitutions and example IP substitutions. Private executed manifests are deliberately excluded.
helpers.runtime-build.sh: Builds an isolated Linux aarch64 verification venv using uv and the exact official base wheel, pins both FlashInfer Python/cubin packages, validates core versions, and prints the dependency inventory. Requires a compatible inherited base image and network access; not an OS lockfile. Run only in a new CPU/memory-bounded container with no GPU devices.
